name: 主题一致性分析
description: 测量 主题一致性 throughout the text.
useCase: 通过不自然一致的主题检测AI文本
mechanism: 比较 直方图 分布s 之间 content segments using cosine similarity. AI text maintains extremely consistent topic signals throughout.
source: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
parameters: 窗口大小: 自适应, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 熵, CV, 相关性
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成的 text
- Language-agnostic 统计 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 误报
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 跨 写作风格s

references.title: Bakhtin et al. (2019) - Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Text
Zellers, R. et al. (2019). Defending Against Neural Fake News. NeurIPS.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
